summary: George Russell converted pole position into a lights-to-flag victory, weathering a charging Max Verstappen in the closing laps amid two late safety car restarts that bunched the field. Russell emerged from a difficult period with what he called "the most dominant weekend I've had in my career," controlling the race from start to finish despite the chaotic final phases. The win strengthens Mercedes' constructors' championship push while Russell reclaims momentum in his personal campaign after a rough stretch of form.
